name: Witness, Virtues and Source Attestations
description: Structured source-aware saint/witness dossier, distinguish deeds, written works, virtues, hagiography, miracles, ecclesial status.
reference_use_case: French Canadian Catholic pastoral curriculum; saints teach through concrete lives without treating miracle accounts as proof.
integrity_rule: Primary writings, attributed deeds, historical documentary evidence, ecclesial judgments and miracle stories must remain separately typed.
antipattern: No automatic canonization or miracles based on AI storytelling.
design_question: Which aspects of this person are directly attested and which belong to reception or devotional tradition?
situational_schema: Person linked to attributed virtues and independent source layers; miracles isolated as their own documentary class.
case_examples: Francis of Assisi primary writings versus hagiography
